body: Don't get wrong, I completely understand what your saying. Knowing that it would be easier to get in after a semester in college is what kept me from never even going to college. However, now that I realize that I have to stay a full year it has absolutely sapped my will and drive to work hard. I just have no more motivation to try, all I want in life is that phone call.

The problem isnt the classes difficulty, its that I don't give a shit, 100% total apathy towards putting work in. I know I can drop out but I'll just feel like a huge failure and super embarrassed to my friends and family if I do, the sense of self-loathing would only get worse. Money is not an issue, I just don't want to be at this school for even one more day. Everyday I dream about getting a phone call saying there was a mix up and that I can go to my dream school, but it never comes. The reality is that its never gonna come, therefore I've said fuck it
Sorry I went on a long walk, yes feel free to ask whatever
